verdict.rationale: ClickUp lists Sprints as a first-party product, and its Jira importer explicitly migrates sprints and epics, so sprint planning is a native capability. Dev-tool integrations (GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket sync, Sentry-to-task) and the Triage Agent support agile engineering workflows around it. The evidence is mostly feature names rather than depth, so missing for 10: documentation of sprint planning mechanics (backlog grooming, sprint points/velocity, burndown/burnup reporting, sprint rollover), and independent or hands-on corroboration of sprint management.
